sentence: On 20 October 2026 the US Food and Drug Administration (FDA) approved Hibsago (bepirovirsen) for chronic hepatitis B.
The FDA says it is the first approved antisense oligonucleotide for chronic hepatitis B.

sentence: It is approved for certain adults without cirrhosis, as an addition to existing antiviral therapy.
